finding: Corruption prefix ladder (Cursed, Contaminated, Polluted) on one base family, carried onto the drop name; zone names are place plus function with a floor suffix for dungeons; guards named by town or castle; quest ladders step through givers at levels 15, 30, 45, 50. Half read: data (SQL, text, quest XML); client absent.

Sign posts (6) and message boards (9) are objects, but their text and all 41 NPC chat lines are client string ids not in the box; ambient NPC shouts are timed rows (13 shouts, 6 repeats); castle war times are scheduled rows (8 castles, 2008 seed dates).

Sign grammar is a name plus one function line, shop signs carry a name and a trade line; map labels have a size class 0-2 and a slash split (107 labels, 56 split); faction by zone and by NPC category (Zamorak 75 files, Saradomin 47, Guthix 30). Half read: data pack plus pack-tool loader; server engine and client not read.

Rumour is a player-chosen dialogue topic whose answer routes to the next NPC (osman.rs2); a three-line zone voice in Zanaris (world rule, identity, one-way ladder with teleport out); 72 rumour-like lines across 1,159 scripts. Donor names a commercial game in dialogue, so category-level only.
